question: What happens to the magnetic field produced by a given current in the conductor when the distance increases?
solution:
The correct answer is __**It decreases.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

 
• The **magnetic field **produced by a given current within the conductor **decreases** because the **distance from it increases.**
 
• A metallic wire carrying an electrical current has** related to it a magnetic field. **</
